prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 中文 · 财务指标 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 6 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "指标" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 154px
  col 2: header "2022 年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 57px
  col 3: header "2023 年" · longest unbreakable word 45px · one-line width 57px
  col 4: header "2024 年" · longest unbreakable word 43px · one-line width 57px
  col 5: header "同比" · longest unbreakable word 54px · one-line width 54px
  col 6: header "备注" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 276px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示五项财务指标在 2022—2024 年的变化，以及同比结果和备注。","reading":"读者先按行识别指标，再横向比较三个年度的数值和同比变化；备注提供补充解释。","groups":["第 2—4 列都是年度数值，应保持一致的宽度和对齐方式，方便跨年比较。","第 5 列是变化结果，与年度数值相邻，便于核对趋势。","第 1 列标识指标，第 6 列提供说明，分别承担识别和解释作用。"],"keep_intact":["年度数值及百分比","同比变化数值及其单位或符号","指标名称中的单位","年份表头"],"may_wrap":["指标名称可在自然语义边界换行。","备注中的说明文字可以自然换行；同一行较高时可容纳这些换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [85, 52, 52, 52, 54, 64] · table 360×800px · row heights [60, 129, 106, 246, 199, 60] · column headers wrapped 3/6 · tallest cell 10 lines · mid-word splits 14
Design r0B: widths [105, 78, 78, 78, 75, 85] · table 500×474px · row heights [36, 83, 60, 129, 129, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 140px
Design r0C: widths [150, 78, 78, 78, 75, 150] · table 610×312px · row heights [36, 60, 36, 83, 60, 36] · column headers wrapped 0/6 · tallest cell 3 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 250px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"整表基本落在首屏，指标、年度、同比和备注都能看到。","problems":"年份表头、年度数值和同比数值被拆开；备注逐字堆叠，使行高悬殊，横向比较很吃力。","cause":"年度列各仅52px，同比列54px，扣除内边距后不足以容纳完整数字或年份；备注列64px也过窄。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"年度列等宽，年份和数值保持完整；首屏能看到三个年度，指标列仍有足够空间辨认名称。","problems":"同比和备注需要横向滚动；长备注形成较高的行，指标名称也有多处换行。","cause":"年度列各78px保证了表头完整，但表格总宽500px；备注列85px限制了说明文字的每行字数，指标列105px也容不下较长名称。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"指标和备注更舒展，行高较低，完整表格的阅读节奏清晰；数字和表头保持完整。","problems":"首屏在2024年列附近结束，同比和备注都在屏外；250px的横向溢出增加了查看完整一行的滚动距离。","cause":"指标列和备注列各150px，改善了换行，但把总宽度推至610px。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-notes","widths":[105,78,78,78,75,120],"change":"以r0B为基础，将备注列从85px增至120px，减少长说明造成的高行；保留等宽年度列和完整数字，同时将总宽控制在535px。"},{"name":"compact-scroll","widths":[90,78,78,78,75,105],"change":"压缩指标列并适度加宽备注列，总宽504px。首屏仍可看到三个完整年度，并露出更多同比列；代价是较长指标名称需要换行。"},{"name":"readable-labels","widths":[125,78,78,78,75,120],"change":"在r0B和r0C之间折中，加宽指标和备注以改善行内文字节奏，总宽555px；首屏能看到三个年度，但同比需滚动查看。"}]}
